summary: Enhance your skills with our Digital Records and Information Management Training Course. Learn best practices for efficient data handling and compliance.
lede: Digital records management helps records and information professionals control electronic records from creation or receipt through retention and authorized disposition. Training covers mapping record sources, designing classification and metadata, and applying retention rules with documented disposition controls. Participants also practise governance, access-control, migration, and preservation planning through templates and workflow designs for managing records across repositories.
audienceIntro: This digital records management course is designed for professionals who create, control, secure, retain, migrate, audit, or govern electronic records.
prerequisites: Prior knowledge: Working experience with records, documents, compliance controls, repositories, or information governance is required. Coding requirement: No coding or programming is required for completion. Technical depth: Metadata, classification, retention, appraisal, and roadmap design receive hands-on operational application. Microsoft Purview and SharePoint configuration receive guided operational coverage. AI-assisted classification and digital preservation architectures receive conceptual awareness with practical control design. Equipment: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet and presentation software. TrainingCred provides exercise datasets and digital records management templates.
